note: Verified resource list for Other Ways to Get Help. Every field comes from the organization's own or an official page fetched on the checked date. Run scripts/check-help-directory.js before any change and at least every 90 days.

entries.name: Legal Services Corporation (LSC) - I Need Legal Help (Find Legal Aid locator)
entries.service: Enter an address or city to find the LSC-funded legal aid organization that serves that area for a civil legal problem.

contact.other: The locator returns the local organization's phone, website and fax; LSC's own office line (T: 202-295-1500) is printed in the footer and is not described as a legal help line.

entries.eligibility_known: LSC describes its mission as funding civil legal aid to low-income Americans; the page states no income test or case-type rules of its own.
entries.unknown: The tool only shows which LSC-funded organization covers an area; it does not establish whether a person qualifies, whether that office is accepting cases, wait times, or non-LSC providers nearby.
entries.source_quote: enter an address or city below to find an LSC-funded legal aid organization near you.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14. The URL linked from USAGov (/get-legal-help) redirects to /i-need-legal-help. The 'For legal help, call' field is filled in only after a location search, so no single phone is published here.

entries.name: LawHelp.org
entries.service: Directory that sends you to your state's site to find free legal help and information about your legal rights from nonprofit legal aid providers.

contact.other: Also links to LawHelp Interactive (free legal document creation), Immi (immigration options) and disaster legal help pages.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated on the homepage; USAGov describes these services as for people with low to moderate incomes.
entries.unknown: The homepage does not say who qualifies with the listed providers or whether any provider is accepting cases.
entries.cost_note: Site says Pro Bono Net's tools and directories are always free to use.
entries.source_quote: Find free legal help and information about your legal rights from nonprofit legal aid providers in your state.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14 via WebFetch (direct curl download failed, so the quote rests on the WebFetch extraction of the page title). Maintained by Pro Bono Net with nonprofit legal aid partners, per the page.

entries.name: ABA Free Legal Answers
entries.service: A virtual legal advice clinic where qualifying users post civil legal questions at no cost, answered by pro bono attorneys licensed in their state.

contact.other: Federal page for immigration and federal veterans' questions: https://abafederal.freelegalanswers.org/. Users in non-participating states are pointed to www.findlegalhelp.org. Answers arrive by email after the user makes an account.

entries.eligibility_known: Qualification is set by a short questionnaire on each state's site (specific income or asset limits are not stated on the national pages); civil questions only; volunteer attorneys will not answer criminal law questions. Participating states listed: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, USVI, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin (Ohio and Wyoming are not on that list).
entries.unknown: The national pages do not give each state's income limits or how long answers take.
entries.cost_note: States 'at no cost' for qualifying users.
entries.source_quote: ABA Free Legal Answers is a virtual legal advice clinic in which qualifying users post civil legal questions at no cost
entries.verification_note: Fetched homepage and /about on 2026-10-14. Inconsistency: the national participating list omits Wyoming, but the Wyoming Judicial Branch links to https://wyoming.freelegalanswers.org/, which is live and describes itself as Wyoming Free Legal Answers.

entries.name: USAGov - Find a lawyer for affordable legal aid
entries.service: Government page listing programs and organizations that give free legal advice and may help you find a free or low-cost attorney.

contact.other: Page prints the USAGov Contact Center, 1-844-USAGOV1 (1-844-872-4681), which is a general government information line, not legal help. Links: LSC, LawHelp.org, law school pro bono directory, LawHelp Interactive, ABA Free Legal Answers, Stateside Legal, VA legal help, Eldercare Locator, Pension Rights Center, National Disability Rights Network.

entries.eligibility_known: Page says some listed programs limit their services to people with low incomes; describes ABA Free Legal Answers as for people with low incomes and not answering questions involving crimes.
entries.unknown: It is a list of links only and does not say whether any listed program is accepting cases.
entries.source_quote: Learn about programs and organizations that give free legal advice and may help you find a free or low-cost attorney.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; text confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: 211 (United Way 211)
entries.service: Connects callers to local help with essentials such as housing expenses, utilities expenses, and food programs and benefits.

contact.other: 'Find your local 211' locator at https://www.211.org/about-us/your-local-211; Spanish site https://www.es.211.org/.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: The page does not say whether texting is available, hours, or what assistance any local 211 can actually provide.
entries.source_quote: 211 connects you to expert, caring help. Every call is completely confidential.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14 (www.211.org redirects to 211.org). No text-message option is printed on the homepage, so text is null.

entries.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
entries.service: Free, confidential emotional support by call, text or chat, available 24/7/365.

contact.other: Chat: https://chat.988lifeline.org/. Page says text and chat services are now available in Spanish. Deaf/HoH options page: https://988lifeline.org/deaf-hard-of-hearing-hearing-loss/.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated; page says 'The 988 Lifeline is for everyone.'
entries.unknown: The homepage does not describe the veterans option or the Deaf/HoH options in detail.
entries.cost_note: Page says conversations are free and confidential.
entries.source_quote: The 988 Lifeline is available 24/7/365. Your conversations are free and confidential.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; Call (tel:988), Text (sms:988) and Chat links confirmed in page HTML.

entries.service: The official emergency number, for emergencies such as reporting a crime in progress, reporting a fire, or requesting an ambulance.

contact.other: FCC: text-to-911 is only available in certain locations; always make a voice call to 911 if you can.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: Whether text-to-911 works at the user's location (FCC says it is only available in certain locations).
entries.source_quote: 911 lines are designated for emergency calls, such as reporting a crime in progress, reporting a fire, or requesting an ambulance.
entries.verification_note: 911.gov returned HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and curl, so the FCC (official federal source) was used instead; text-to-911 guidance from https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/what-you-need-know-about-text-911.

entries.name: The State Bar of California - Find a Lawyer Referral Service (certified LRS directory)
entries.service: Directory of lawyer referral services certified by the State Bar, searchable by county, area of law and languages spoken; the State Bar itself does not make referrals.

contact.other: No referral phone line is printed on the fetched pages; only State Bar office lines (415-538-2000 San Francisco, 213-765-1000 Los Angeles). A search snippet attributed 866-44-CA-LAW (866-442-2529) to a calbar.ca.gov page, but it was not found on any page fetched, so it is NOT verified.

entries.eligibility_known: Certified services may refer to lawyers offering reduced rates based on income; no income test stated.
entries.unknown: Each certified service's fee, phone and hours are not on this page and must be taken from the directory entry.
entries.cost_note: Page says referred lawyers offer an initial consultation for a reduced fee or no fee; exact amounts vary by service and are not stated.
entries.source_quote: Please note that the State Bar is not a Lawyer Referral Service and cannot direct you to a lawyer or give legal advice.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14 via WebFetch (calbar.ca.gov refuses curl). The State Bar does not run a referral service; it certifies them. Phone left null because no public referral number appears on the current pages.

entries.name: Self-Help Guide to the California Courts
entries.service: Step-by-step guides and information to help people navigate a court case, plus Self-Help Centers that give legal information to people without a lawyer.

contact.other: Site says Self-Help Center help can be in person, over the phone, or online; it links to 'Find a Free or Low-Cost Lawyer'.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: The homepage gives no phone number, hours, or local Self-Help Center wait times.
entries.source_quote: Self-Help Centers can provide legal information and resources to people without a lawyer.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; text confirmed in downloaded page (official judicial branch site, courts.ca.gov).

entries.name: State Bar of Texas Lawyer Referral & Information Service (LRIS)
entries.service: Bar-run referral service that matches callers with a lawyer or other resource for their legal need; staff do not give legal advice.

contact.other: Hours: Monday - Friday, CST, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; closed legal holidays; Se habla Espanol. Residents of Bexar, Dallas, Harris, Jefferson, Travis and Tarrant counties are sent to their local certified referral service. Online resources: www.texasbar.com/selfservice. State Bar main line printed in footer: 800.204.2222.

entries.eligibility_known: Serves counties other than the six listed above; requires name, zip code and phone number to make a referral; LRIS has no participating attorneys who offer free or reduced-fee help.
entries.unknown: The page does not state wait times or what the lawyer will charge after the first consultation.
entries.cost_note: Referred lawyer provides up to a 30 minute consultation for no more than $20; later fees are set by agreement with the lawyer.
entries.source_quote: The lawyer we refer you to will provide you with up to a 30 minute consultation for no more than $20.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; phone, hours and fee confirmed in downloaded page. Page states the service is certified as a lawyer referral service.

entries.name: Texas Judicial Branch - Help for Self-Represented Litigants
entries.service: Court system page pointing people without a lawyer to TexasCourtHelp.org, the State Law Library, and court-approved forms such as the Protective Order Kit and uncontested divorce forms.

contact.other: TexasCourtHelp.org (created by the Office of Court Administration with the Texas Access to Justice Commission): https://www.texascourthelp.org/. State Law Library Ask a Librarian by email.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated; the page says its information is not legal advice.
entries.unknown: The pages give no phone line or staffed help desk for self-represented litigants.
entries.source_quote: has created a self-help resources internet website for pro se parties (representing one's self): www.texascourthelp.org
entries.verification_note: Fetched both txcourts.gov pages on 2026-10-14; quotes confirmed in downloaded text.

entries.name: The Florida Bar Lawyer Referral Service
entries.service: Bar-run referral service that matches consumers with a lawyer based on their legal situation and location, by phone or online request.

contact.other: Also printed as 1-800-342-8011. Phone hours Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m.; online referral request available 24-7. Local bar associations run nine referral services in Florida's major cities; the Florida Bar handles areas without a local service. Spanish and Haitian Creole pages available.

entries.eligibility_known: Page says it does not have pro bono lawyers and points to Florida legal aid programs (https://fundingfla.org/florida-legal-aid-programs/).
entries.unknown: The page does not state wait times or what lawyers charge after the first consultation.
entries.source_quote: Call 800-342-8011, Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; phone, hours and $25 fee confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: Florida Courts - Self-Help Information
entries.service: Information for people who want to handle their own cases related to family law and certain other legal matters, with family law forms and local self-help programs listed by judicial circuit.

contact.other: Self-help programs list: https://www.flcourts.gov/Services/family-courts/self-help-information/self-help-programs. Page tip: many locations require an appointment, call first. Footer phone (850) 922-5081 is the Office of the State Courts Administrator, not a self-help line.

entries.eligibility_known: Self-help programs are described as assisting self-represented litigants with family law cases; staff may provide information and approved forms but not legal advice.
entries.unknown: The page does not say whether a given local program takes walk-ins, its hours, or wait times.
entries.source_quote: Information for people who would like to handle their own cases related to family law and certain other legal matters in Florida.
entries.verification_note: The older URL /Resources-Services/Court-Improvement/Family-Courts/Self-Help-Information returns a 404 page; current URL found and fetched 2026-10-14. Content is rendered by script, so quotes were read from the page's embedded content data.

entries.name: Ohio State Bar Association - Lawyer Referral Services (county directory)
entries.service: The Ohio State Bar's page does not list a statewide OSBA referral service; it lists county and local bar lawyer referral services and points to the Supreme Court of Ohio's registry.

contact.other: Numbers that MATCH on both the OSBA page and the Supreme Court of Ohio 2026 registry: Akron Bar Association (330) 253-5038; Butler County Bar Association (513) 896-6671; Cincinnati Bar Association (513) 381-8359; Mahoning County Bar Association (330) 746-2933; Medina County Bar Association (330) 725-9794; Pro Seniors (age 60+) (513) 345-4160 (OSBA also lists (800) 488-6070). Numbers that DIFFER between the two official lists are omitted here (see verification_note). Supreme Court registry: https://www.supremecourt.ohio.gov/attorneys/referral-services/

entries.eligibility_known: Pro Seniors line is for persons over the age of 60; no other limits stated.
entries.unknown: The pages do not state consultation fees, hours, or whether each county service is currently taking referrals.
entries.source_quote: All lawyer referral information services (LRIS) must be registered with the Supreme Court of Ohio.
entries.verification_note: Fetched OSBA page (content read from page data; it renders by script) and the Supreme Court of Ohio registered LRIS PDF dated 7/22/2026 on 2026-10-14. OSBA itself does not appear on the 2026 registry. Phone conflicts: Cleveland Metropolitan Bar (216) 696-3525 (OSBA) vs (216) 696-3532 (Supreme Court); Toledo (419) 242-2000 vs (419) 242-9363; Dayton (937) 222-6102 vs (937) 222-7902; Stark County (330) 453-0686 vs (330) 453-0685. OSBA lists Allen, Columbus, Lake, Lorain and Trumbull county bars, which are not on the 2026 Supreme Court registry.

entries.name: Supreme Court of Ohio - Access to Justice Resources
entries.service: Court page for people seeking legal help, with self-representation resources such as Keys to the Courtroom (court procedures for representing yourself in a civil case), limited scope representation, and a link to Ohio Legal Help.

contact.other: Page prints a Legal Aid line: 1-866-LAW-OHIO (866.529.6446), to reach the local legal aid office. Ohio Legal Help: https://www.ohiolegalhelp.org/. Court main line 614.387.9000 (not a self-help line).

entries.eligibility_known: none stated for self-help resources; legal aid offices are not described with an income test on this page.
entries.unknown: The page does not describe a statewide staffed self-help center, hours, or wait times.
entries.source_quote: Call 1-866-LAW-OHIO (866.529.6446) to contact the local office that serves your area.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; Ohio has no single court self-help portal on the judiciary site, so this Access to Justice page is the closest official equivalent.

entries.name: Maryland State Bar Association - For The Public (county bar referral contacts)
entries.service: The MSBA does not list a statewide referral service of its own; it tells the public to contact their county's bar association to find a lawyer.

contact.other: The MSBA page lists county bar contacts. Several county numbers on it appear inconsistent (for example, two counties show the same number), so look up your county bar's number on that bar's own website.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: Which county lines are referral services, their fees, and whether lawyers are taking new clients.
entries.source_quote: Your county's bar association can help you find a lawyer in your area.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14. The older MSBA referral URL (/public/lawyer-referral.aspx) returns 404. Possible data issues: Charles County is listed with (301) 952-1440, the same as Prince George's; Carroll and Frederick share Baltimore County's (410) 337-9100. A search snippet gave the Bar Association of Baltimore City LRIS as 410-539-5936, different from MSBA's (410) 539-3112; not verified on the county bar's site. County numbers removed from this entry on 2026-10-14 because the MSBA page shows inconsistent numbers; do not restore them without checking each county bar's own site.

entries.name: Maryland Court Help Centers
entries.service: Free legal help in civil cases for individuals who do not have a lawyer, by phone, live chat, and in person.

contact.other: Printed with 'from 8:30 a.m. until 8:00 p.m.' (days not stated on this page). Call or Chat: https://www.mdcourts.gov/helpcenter/mchc. In-person: Family Law, Circuit Court and District Court Help Centers. Page warns the Help Center will never ask for payment information. Temporary closure notice for the Upper Marlboro District Court Help Center.

entries.eligibility_known: Civil cases, for individuals who do not have a lawyer.
entries.unknown: The page does not state which days the phone line is open or current wait times.
entries.source_quote: FREE legal help in civil cases for individuals who do not have a lawyer.
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; phone, hours and quote confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: Wyoming State Bar - Lawyer Search and Referral
entries.service: Bar-run referral program: an online referral request reviewed by the Lawyer Referral Coordinator, who emails a referral, plus a directory of attorneys in the referral program.

contact.other: (307) 432-2107 is printed for questions about the referral request. Bar main line: 307-632-9061; fax 307-632-3737. Referral directory: https://www.wyomingbar.org/for-the-public/hire-a-lawyer/lawyer-search/. Page advises not to include sensitive or confidential information in the form.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated for the referral service. Separate Modest Means Program: household incomes between 200% and 300% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines; reduced fees apply.
entries.unknown: The pages do not state any referral consultation fee or whether participating lawyers are taking new clients.
entries.cost_note: No referral fee stated. Modest Means Program attorneys charge no more than $100 an hour and no more than a $1,000 retainer (if necessary).
entries.source_quote: Each referral request is reviewed by our Lawyer Referral Coordinator.
entries.verification_note: Fetched referral request, lawyer search and Modest Means pages on 2026-10-14 (Modest Means terms from https://www.wyomingbar.org/for-the-public/hire-a-lawyer/modest-means-program/). Page says referrals are emailed within one or two business days.

entries.name: Wyoming Judicial Branch - Equal Justice Wyoming / Self-Help Forms
entries.service: Judicial branch legal help hub with self-help court forms, an interactive guide to legal help, and links to free legal help for income-eligible Wyoming residents.

contact.other: Self-Help Forms: https://www.wyocourts.gov/self-help-forms/. Wyoming Free Legal Answers: https://wyoming.freelegalanswers.org/. Court phone numbers printed (Supreme Court Clerk 307-777-7316, State Law Library 307-777-7509, Court Administration 307-777-7687) are not described as self-help lines.

entries.eligibility_known: Legal aid resources are described for income-eligible Wyoming citizens; the forms page says by law the courts cannot provide legal advice.
entries.unknown: The pages do not describe a staffed self-help desk, hours, or wait times.
entries.source_quote: Please Note: By law, the Courts cannot provide legal advice.
entries.verification_note: courts.state.wy.us/legal-help/ redirects to wyocourts.gov/legal-help/; both that page and the Self-Help Forms page fetched 2026-10-14.

entries.name: Find a Solicitor (The Law Society)
entries.service: Free search of the official database of SRA-regulated organisations and people providing legal services in England and Wales, by legal issue and location.

contact.other: Support Centre for help using the website is open 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, via an online enquiry form; no phone number is printed on the page.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: The search does not say whether a listed solicitor offers free first consultations, legal aid, or is taking new clients.
entries.cost_note: The search service itself is described as free; solicitors' fees are not stated.
entries.source_quote: Find a Solicitor is a free service for anyone looking for information about organisations or people providing legal services in England and Wales
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; text confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: Citizens Advice
entries.service: National phone line that connects you to a local Citizens Advice adviser, plus online chat and a postcode search for your nearest Citizens Advice.

contact.other: Printed as 'Adviceline (England): 0800 144 8848'. Relay UK: 18001 then 0800 144 8848. Debt helpline: 0800 240 4420. Wales uses a separate Advicelink line (see the Wales contact page). Hours: usually 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, not on public holidays.

entries.eligibility_known: Most local Citizens Advice can only help you if you live or work in their area; a few parts of England are not covered yet.
entries.unknown: Whether advice on a particular legal issue is available locally; the page warns waits of up to an hour at busy times.
entries.cost_note: Calls to Adviceline are free from mobiles and landlines.
entries.source_quote: Adviceline (England): 0800 144 8848
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14 (contact URL redirects to /about-us/contact-us/); number, hours and Relay UK details confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: Samaritans
entries.service: Listening support for anyone who needs someone to talk to, by phone any time, day or night.

contact.other: Relay UK: 18001 44 116 123. Web chat is a small-scale pilot shown as not currently available; the email service has closed. Some branches offer in-person visits.

entries.eligibility_known: none stated; frequent callers (100+ calls or 20+ hours in a rolling 30 days) may have calls limited.
entries.unknown: Whether the web chat pilot is open to a given user at a given time.
entries.cost_note: Free to call from landlines and mobiles, including pay-as-you-go with no credit.
entries.source_quote: Whatever you're going through, you can call us any time, from any phone for FREE. Call 116 123
entries.verification_note: Fetched 2026-10-14; text confirmed in downloaded page.

entries.name: 999 emergency number
entries.service: Call 999 to report a crime in progress, if someone is in immediate danger, or for life-threatening medical emergencies.

contact.other: Police non-emergency: 101. If unsure whether a medical problem needs 999, NHS 111 (https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/urgent-and-emergency-care-services/when-to-call-999/).

entries.eligibility_known: none stated
entries.unknown: Nothing material for this purpose.
entries.cost_note: GOV.UK says calls to 999, 101 or 0800 numbers are free.
entries.source_quote: Call 999 if you are reporting a crime that is in progress or if someone is in immediate danger.
